component.name: Redunar
component.summary: Capture recent gameplay and view in-game metrics

description.p: Redunar is a Linux app for Steam gameplay, with instant replays and in-game metrics built for AMD hardware.
It keeps game profiles, measurements, and recorded media on the user's machine. It does not require an online account or upload telemetry.
Fixes Steam Play launches on X11, adds optional microphone recording mixed with game sound in Replay clips, and reduces replay gaps caused by short encoder bursts overflowing the recording queue.
Keeps Replay save controls aligned when changing duration, distinguishes pending frames from errors, and fixes incomplete Vulkan extension discovery for the NVIDIA beta encoder.
Uses a temporary tray icon for automatic Steam startup and closing Redunar during a game. With Close to tray disabled, Redunar quits after the game ends unless reopened.
Fixes the in-game Replay menu disappearing immediately after opening and refreshes mouse devices when opening the menu after a reconnect.

Uses a native desktop tray without AppIndicator, accepts ultrawide Replay sources within the existing recording budget, reads Intel CPU package temperatures, and preserves privately loaded GLX provider calls.

Starts capture for configured Steam launches, simplifies Steam setup, fixes background app lifetime after game exit, and matches Replay to the game's GPU. Identifiable NVIDIA hybrid systems can attempt the beta path; NVIDIA hardware support remains unverified.

Improves Replay saving, playback timing, shortcut recovery, and producer handoff; hardens experimental NVIDIA capture and metrics; and improves local diagnostic logging. NVIDIA hardware support remains unverified.
Fixes Replay menu visibility and sound timing in Instant Replay clips.
Fixes Open log folder in Settings.
Adds Variable FPS recording for accepted game presents alongside fixed 60 FPS; improves NVIDIA Replay beta diagnostics and frame release recovery.
Installs signed updates directly after a polkit authorization prompt, with retryable cancellation and installed-package confirmation.
Refreshes Settings by grouping Close to tray, Beta access, and Debug log in one Preferences card, with updated switches and shorter descriptions.

Refines the in-game metrics overlay and Replay menu. Adds opt-in Beta access for experimental NVIDIA GPU metrics and a single-GPU Vulkan Video Replay candidate. NVIDIA hardware has not yet been verified.
Adds GLX/SDL OpenGL metrics, overlay, and supported Instant Replay capture; preserves game music by preferring native PipeWire audio capture; and adds an opt-in rotating debug log for tester reports.

Redesigns the in-game Replay menu with live buffer status, direct saving, and live MKV/MP4 selection; applies Replay shortcut and format changes to active sessions; and adds a compact titlebar independent of the Linux desktop compositor.

Records the active system output through PulseAudio or PipeWire with automatic recovery, adds optional in-game overlay branding, removes the obsolete desktop Replay preview, and fixes bounded trimmed-clip exports.

Improves Instant Replay audio routing and retention, preserves clip game names during immediate refreshes, cancels obsolete playback preparation, protects game imports and launch edits from stale UI state, and fixes overlay preview palette borders.

Initial scoped release for x86_64 Linux with AMD/RADV hardware and Steam games. Includes Instant Replay recording, in-game metrics, session history, clip editing, signed update metadata, and clean startup Overview state.
